findings: Identity source exists and is clean enough for staging, but native 1x visual approval is still pending.
The visual target is original and uses indigo/cyan/amber as a shared roster contrast plan.

game_design_context.gameplay_role: D1 opponent and first vertical-slice rival; powers fighter with readable projectile and aerial branch
interaction_context: Kairo must remain taller than Jack/Ryo at the locked D1 probe.
Scarf is a signature secondary-motion marker, not a hitbox shortcut.
Cyan energy must share the special-meter/FX language and remain readable over the stage.
Ground contact and hands must survive at 320x224 native size.

must_preserve.expected: Asymmetric scarf tail creates the primary silhouette hook.
Sleeveless indigo coat with cyan seam language.
Amber wrist/gauntlet accents distinguish the fighter from Jack and Ryo.
Cyan energy is reserved for powers and meter feedback.
Complete feet and forward pressure read at 1x.

secondary_motion: Scarf tail follows torso acceleration with one-frame delay in future strips.
expression_requirements: Focused neutral for idle; narrowed eyes and open mouth for CS-A/special.
state_fantasy_checks: Aerial power action must read as controlled stellar projection, not generic recolor.
